title: Derive offload
description: The machines a repository's derive may be offloaded to, under .ai/repo/offload/: each host's ssh address and identity file, the free space a host must have to be chosen, the FIFO queue and the lock every waiter on a host joins, and the layout of a host (its checkout, the worktrees, the shared build directory every derive clones its own from, and the command that derives). `majordomus offload` reads it and nothing else does; no host address belongs in a script. Nothing secret belongs here: an identity file is named, never carried.

schema.description: The format version of this object. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The declaration's identity within the kind. A repository declares one.

description.description: What the declaration is for, in a sentence a person reads.

base.description: The ref the bundle is cut against (default origin/master): the host has every commit it reaches, so only the branch's own commits travel.

min_free_gib.description: GiB that must be free under a host's home directory for it to be chosen (default 10). A host may state its own.

queue.description: The FIFO queue on every host: one ticket file per waiter, named <arrival>-<pid>-<tag>, served oldest first; the lock is a directory made by mkdir holding one file per process of the derive that holds it.

directory.description: The ticket directory, absolute on the host (default /tmp/offload-queue).

lock.description: The lock directory, absolute on the host (default /tmp/offload-derive.lock).

poll_seconds.description: Seconds between looks at the queue (default 5).

wait_max_seconds.description: Seconds a waiter waits in all before it withdraws (default 14400).

remote.description: The layout of a host, each path relative to the host's home unless absolute.

checkout.description: The host's checkout of this repository (default dev/prismatic-majordomus).

worktrees.description: Where each derive's detached worktree offload-<tag> is made (default dev/prismatic-majordomus-wt).

target.description: The shared build directory each derive's private one is cloned from, copy-on-write where the filesystem can (default .cache/majordomus-offload-target).

spool.description: Where the bundles and the derive's log are written on the host (default /tmp).

path.description: Directories put before the host's PATH.

derive.description: The command that derives, relative to the worktree (default scripts/derive).

touch.description: Files touched before the derive, so a build directory cloned from another tree's build never judges this tree's sources older than its executable.

hosts.description: The machines that may derive, in the order a tie between them is broken.

id.description: A short name, unique in the declaration: what --host names.

identity_file.description: The ssh identity file, when the host needs one; ~/ is the invoking user's home.

min_free_gib.description: This host's own free-space minimum in GiB.

description.description: What the machine is, for a person.
